evidence.positive:
Against the running app (mayo-mayo tenant), created an adult male patient 110 kg / 175 cm via POST /api/admin/patients/, a case via operations/create, then POST /api/cds/medication-selection/{pmrn}/42859 with medicationIdentifier m-vancomycin-iv. Response perRouteState.INTRAVENOUS listed the 15 mg/kg option as defaultOption:true with calculatedDoseAmount "1.75" g and weightBasedDoseCalculation "15 mg/kg × 110 kg (recorded weight)
=1,650 mg, rounded to the nearest 0.2 g
≈1.75 g". DB: rule_execution_contexts.weight_type = ACTUAL and the w-default-dose-adjustment firing details carried WEIGHT_TYPE "recorded weight", TYPED_WEIGHT 110 kg ACTUAL; app log showed "Rule evaluated: w-weight-type-adjustment -> false no weight type adjustments found". The shipped Mayo adjustment_mappings NORMAL row for m-vancomycin-iv holds only the default_dose adjustment (no weight_type entry). A 60 kg patient preselected 1 g from recorded weight, and a 150 kg patient preselected 2.25 g from recorded weight. Backfill: with the pre-fix config active (see red check) a 1.75 g administration was tracked against the ideal-weight firing and scored default-dose compliant=false; after inserting a BODY_WEIGHT 110 kg observation one hour before the firing and running changeset 243's SQL body by hand in the mayo-mayo schema, the statement reported UPDATE 1, compliance_results.compliant flipped to true, and rule_fired_results.route_default_dose_override was rewritten to calculatedDoseAmount 1.75 g with the recorded-weight calculation text identical to the app's own output; a second run reported UPDATE 0 and the two actual-weight firings were untouched.
evidence.negative: Same 110 kg Mayo patient on the shipped build never received the ideal-weight dose: no option carried "(ideal weight)" text, the default was 1.75 g not 1 g, and the full container log contained zero "kg (ideal weight)" lines outside the red-check window. MGB unchanged: created a 110 kg / 175 cm patient in mgb-mgh and selected m-vancomycin-iv; the default was the fixed 2 g OVERWEIGHT1 group dose (defaultOption:true on the 2 g option, the 15 mg/kg option present but not default), matching MGB's fixed-dose-by-weight-group table. The 60 kg Mayo patient on the shipped build produced no "was less than calculated (IDEAL) weight" log line, confirming the actual-if-at-or-below-ideal fallback is gone for vancomycin.
evidence.red_check:
Flipped the data through the real admin path: uploaded the parent commit's Mayo DoseAdjustments.xlsx (git show ecefa57d2^) via POST /api/admin/config-imports/dose-adjustments/upload with X-Tenant-Id mayo-mayo (REPLACE_ALL semantics, cache refreshed; log "Imported dose-adjustments for tenant mayo-mayo"). DB then showed the NORMAL m-vancomycin-iv row with {"weightCalculationType":"IDEAL",...,"@type":"weight_type"}. Re-selecting vancomycin on the same 110 kg patient/case went red: default 15 mg/kg calculated "1" g with "15 mg/kg × 70.5 kg (ideal weight)
=1,056.97 mg", log "Rule evaluated: w-weight-type-adjustment -> true", rule_execution_contexts.weight_type = IDEAL. A new 60 kg patient under the flipped config logged "Actual weight '60 kg' was less than calculated (IDEAL) weight '70.46456 kg'. Will use actual weight." (the pre-fix fallback). Reverted by uploading the shipped spreadsheet (md5 b8feb50c9b8f5215776e4a56aed3e843, equal to /app/resources/data/org/mayo/medications/DoseAdjustments.xlsx in the container, which was never modified); DB row returned to default_dose only, re-selection on the 110 kg patient returned 1.75 g recorded weight, the 60 kg patient produced no IDEAL log line, and w-weight-type-adjustment evaluated false again. The signature appears exactly once in the full container log, inside the flip window.

red_check_signature: was less than calculated (IDEAL) weight '70.46456 kg'. Will use actual weight.
caveats: Changeset 243 did not run through Liquibase here (context @prod, so it was neither EXECUTED nor MARK_RAN locally); its SQL body was executed by hand in the mayo-mayo schema against rows produced by the pre-fix config, but the @prod context and the current_schema precondition were not exercised.

The backfill reads the patient's weight from patient_observations BODY_WEIGHT at or before the firing; admin-created patients have no such row, so one was inserted by SQL. Prod Mayo firings without a BODY_WEIGHT observation at or before the firing will be skipped silently.
A 150 kg Mayo patient now preselects 2.25 g with no upper cap applied; the ticket lists the upper limit as an open question with Mayo clinical, not a deliverable here.

Pre-existing display glitch, not introduced by this change: the calculation text says "rounded to the nearest 0.2 g" for the 0.25 g step (changeset 243 reproduces the same text deliberately to match the app).
Mayo citations r-vancomycin-iv-default-dose / underweight-dose still show the other site's fixed-dose guideline; the ticket defers that to the live-mode citation pass.
Validation drove the API (medication-selection and medication-administration endpoints) rather than the React dosing form; the UI renders the same perRouteState payload.

automation.assessment: Backend coverage shipped with the PR: MayoVancomycinDefaultDoseTest asserts the worked example (110 kg male 175 cm → 1.75 g actual weight) from the real Mayo spreadsheet, and WeightDoseAdjustmentImporterTest covers Actual/blank/unknown weight types parsing to actual and Ideal still parsing. No qa-suite test touches vancomycin at all, and nothing locks in the MGB-unchanged contract or the absence of the ideal-weight text at the API/UI boundary. The backfill changeset has no automated test; per repo convention tenant migrations are validated manually.
proposed_tests: qa-suite clinical-rules @supplemental (Mayo tenant): 110 kg / 175 cm adult male selects Vancomycin IV → 15 mg/kg option is default at 1.75 g, calculation text contains "(recorded weight)" and never "(ideal weight)".
qa-suite clinical-rules @supplemental (MGB tenant): same 110 kg patient selects Vancomycin IV → fixed 2 g option is default and the 15 mg/kg option is not.
qa-suite clinical-rules @supplemental (Mayo tenant): 60 kg patient selects Vancomycin IV → default 1 g from recorded weight (actual ≤ ideal path no longer labelled ideal).

jira_comment:
Verdict: deploy-ready.

Positive: A 110 kg Mayo patient selecting vancomycin IV preselected 1.75 g from recorded weight, and the backfill SQL rescored an ideal-weight firing with a 1.75 g dose to compliant and rewrote its stored default.
Negative: The same Mayo patient never received the 1 g ideal-weight dose, and a 110 kg MGB patient still got the fixed 2 g group default.
Red check: Uploading the pre-fix Mayo dose adjustment sheet through the admin config import made the default fall to 1 g from 70.5 kg ideal weight with the IDEAL fallback log line, then uploading the shipped sheet restored 1.75 g.

Automation: Backend tests shipped with the PR; proposed qa-suite supplemental checks for the Mayo 1.75 g default, the MGB fixed dose, and the absence of ideal-weight text.
